comment: Global Secure Access web content filtering can't inspect QUIC/HTTP-3 (UDP 443) - matching
traffic bypasses the web content filtering policy entirely rather than falling through to the
policy's default action. Chrome enables QUIC by default whenever a site advertises support for
it, which is common on CDNs fronting game sites. Setting QuicAllowed=false forces Chrome onto
TCP/443, which Global Secure Access can inspect via SNI and evaluate against the filtering policy.
Graph requires payloadJson to be base64-encoded JSON, not a raw JSON string (see
android-defender-gsa-child.json for the same requirement). The decoded value is:
name: android-chrome-quic-child
